'''November 2001 Melbourne tournament (11 November)''' was a Star Wars CCG local tournament held in Oz on Collins, Melbourne, Australia on 11 November 2001. It is known from Haakon ".prototype." Geburtstag's tournament report.<ref name="tr-d3101">[https://www.stephenskilton.com/decktech_archives/reports/2001-11-11-melbourne-oz-11-11-2001d3101/ melbourne-oz-11-11-2001], DeckTech (Haakon ".prototype." Geburtstag, 11 November 2001). Preservation copy: [https://stevetotheizz0.github.io/decktech_archives/reports/2001-11-11-melbourne-oz-11-11-2001d3101/ GitHub Pages].</ref>

* '''Date:''' 11 November 2001
* '''Site:''' Oz on Collins, Melbourne, Australia
* '''Format:''' [[Premiere - Reflections III]]
